text:
incident-bot: PROD pager — model-serving error_rate spike for model 'text-gen-v2' (team: eng-runtime). 5xx surge detected in us-east-1. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/model-serving. Paging oncall now. :rotating_light:

bob_oncall: I'm oncall — looking. Seeing ~12% 5xx across request-tier, ~600rps failing, started ~8076543150. Gathering logs.

alice_sre: checking canary stacks — logs show tokenizer errors ("unknown token id") and weight load failures: checksum mismatch on several canary hosts. Pasting excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T10:05:xxZ runtime ERROR tokenize: unknown token id 0x9f at pos 42
2026-03-17T10:05:xxZ loader ERROR weights: checksum mismatch expected=ab12cd got=ff33aa
```

charlie_eng: I pulled the deploy metadata. It looks like the artifact manifest promoted to canary references weightset `wset-202604` and tokenizer `tkn-v1.3` but stable production expects `wset-202603` + `tkn-v1.2`. Suspect promotion job race. Manifest snippet:
```
artifact: text-gen-v2
promoted: release-2026-04
weights: wset-202604
tokenizer: tkn-v1.3
expected-weights: wset-202603
expected-tokenizer: tkn-v1.2
```

dana_product: Do we have customer impact? Which customers hit errors?

emma_support: Two enterprise customers (acct-142, acct-889) reported failed responses starting ~8076543160. CS flagged high severity. Escalating to account teams.

bob_oncall: Given mismatch and ongoing 5xx, recommend kill-switch -> flip feature flag to stop routing to the bumped variant and revert traffic to stable. Options: `/feature-flag set text-gen-v2.use_latest false` or `/rollout cancel release-2026-04`. I'll execute safe rollback now. :warning:

deploy-bot: Command received: `/feature-flag set text-gen-v2.use_latest false` by bob_oncall at 8076543240. Feature flag toggled. Routing changed: canary traffic stopped; traffic routed back to stable variant `text-gen-v1`.

alice_sre: Post-toggle metrics: 5xx in us-east dropped from ~12% -> 0.6% within 90s. Canary nodes quarantined and marked for diagnostics. :white_check_mark:

charlie_eng: Root cause confirmed: CI promotion job (promote-artifact pipeline) raced with a parallel weight conversion job; wrong weightset label was attached to release tag. Creating hotpatch to gate promotions on weight+tokenizer manifest checksum equality. PR #4321 opened.

dana_product: Impact window estimated ~8076543150 - 8076543240 (~1m30s). Need a short customer note and follow-up. Assigning outreach to Emma.

emma_support: Will prepare customer communications and open tickets for acct-142 and acct-889. Draft ETA 20m, will include apology, mitigation summary, and postmortem link when available.

bob_oncall: Handing off ops to alice_sre for postmortem and cleanup. Creating follow-up channel `#inc-8076543210` and filing incident with severity P1. Incident state: mitigated, monitoring. Closing pager for now — will update channel with RCA timeline.

(reacts: :rotating_light: by alice_sre, :white_check_mark: by deploy-bot)
